Build prompt

Build “Boutique Bakery Custom Cake Order Form” on NeoApps for an independent baker. Collect tier, flavor, allergy notes and pickup date. Configure base prices, a fondant surcharge and daily capacity. Give staff a private prep list. Open only the submission or booking form to the public and keep the organizer view private. Include a demo with fictional records.
